company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech serving exporters with business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance. Its work spans payments, risk, data and client experience, with a focus on simplifying services and moving quickly for clients.

The company’s stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and supporting colleagues, taking responsibility and learning from setbacks, and reducing unnecessary complexity. It describes a collaborative, commercially driven environment, with hybrid working—typically three days a week in the office—and teams spread across around 40 offices. Halden Pay also highlights career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring in every department. Employee reviews mention friendly colleagues, while noting that onboarding and training can vary between teams; reported culture ratings are around 3.3–3.4 out of 5.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
